delta.text: This
confirms it: `src/org/exist/system.properties` has never contained an `exist.home` key — it's a build-time properties file for version/build/vendor info, not J
VM system properties. The commit `3dc5041e2` changed the `exist.home` lookup from `System.getProperty("exist.home")` to `SystemProperties.getInstance().getSyst
emProperty("exist.home", "unknown")`, which reads from this properties file instead of the JVM system property, so it always logged "unknown". This is exactly what

`a8726173a` reverts.

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: 3dc5041e20f5949a6773f

a00fab20aa6af60ab14

## Reasoning
(1) I traced the
history of `src/org/exist/jetty/JettyStart.java` looking for prior changes to the "eXist Home" logging line, since

the fix reverted `SystemProperties.getInstance().getSystemProperty("exist.home", ...)` back to `System.getProperty("exist.home", ...)`.

(2) Commit `3dc5041e2` ("
Ensure access to org/exist/system.properties is consistent...") refactored the startup logging to route several previously ad-hoc property lookups (`product-version
`, `product-build`, `svn-revision`) through the new `SystemProperties` helper (backed by `org/exist/system.properties`). In doing so it also m
istakenly converted the `exist.home` lookup from `System.getProperty("exist.home")` (a JVM system property, set at launch) to `SystemProperties.getInstance().getS

ystemProperty("exist.home", "unknown")` — treating it as if it were one of the build-time properties in `system.properties`.

(3) I confirmed `src/org/exist/system.properties` only contains `vendor`,
`vendor-url`, `product-name`, `product-version`, `product-semver`, `product-build`, and `git-commit` — there is no `exist.home` entry and never has been. So after `
3dc5041e2`, the "eXist Home" log line would always print "unknown" instead of the actual home directory. The fix commit `a8726173a` reverts exactly this one
lookup back to `System.getProperty`, matching the pre-`3dc5041e2` behavior. I'm confident in this attribution.

content.text:
This confirms it: `src/org/exist/system.properties` has never contained an `exist.home` key — it's a build-time properties file for version/build/vendor info, not JVM system properties. The commit `3dc5041e2` changed the `exist.home` lookup from `System.getProperty("exist.home")` to `SystemProperties.getInstance().getSystemProperty("exist.home", "unknown")`, which reads from this properties file instead of the JVM system property, so it always logged "unknown". This is exactly what `a8726173a` reverts.

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: 3dc5041e20f5949a6773fa00fab20aa6af60ab14

## Reasoning
(1) I traced the history of `src/org/exist/jetty/JettyStart.java` looking for prior changes to the "eXist Home" logging line, since the fix reverted `SystemProperties.getInstance().getSystemProperty("exist.home", ...)` back to `System.getProperty("exist.home", ...)`.

(2) Commit `3dc5041e2` ("Ensure access to org/exist/system.properties is consistent...") refactored the startup logging to route several previously ad-hoc property lookups (`product-version`, `product-build`, `svn-revision`) through the new `SystemProperties` helper (backed by `org/exist/system.properties`). In doing so it also mistakenly converted the `exist.home` lookup from `System.getProperty("exist.home")` (a JVM system property, set at launch) to `SystemProperties.getInstance().getSystemProperty("exist.home", "unknown")` — treating it as if it were one of the build-time properties in `system.properties`.

(3) I confirmed `src/org/exist/system.properties` only contains `vendor`, `vendor-url`, `product-name`, `product-version`, `product-semver`, `product-build`, and `git-commit` — there is no `exist.home` entry and never has been. So after `3dc5041e2`, the "eXist Home" log line would always print "unknown" instead of the actual home directory. The fix commit `a8726173a` reverts exactly this one lookup back to `System.getProperty`, matching the pre-`3dc5041e2` behavior. I'm confident in this attribution.
